delivered.statement: Q3 sales Rs.1,54,691 million, up 15.1% YoY
EBITDA Rs.49,485 million, up 23.4% YoY; margin 31.9%
Net profit Rs.33,688 million, up 16% YoY
Global Innovative Medicines US$423 million, up 14.3%; ex-milestone 13.2%
India formulations Rs.49,986 million, up 16.2%; #1 with 8.4% share
India volume growth 6.3% vs IPM 1.2%; launched 12 new products
Emerging markets formulations US$337 million, up 21.6% reported / 13% cc
Net cash US$3.2 billion; interim dividend Rs.11 per share declared

themes: Innovative medicine launches driving growth: Unloxcyt, Ilumya, LEQSELVI momentum
India market leadership with volume growth outpacing IPM growth
Emerging markets expansion delivering double-digit reported growth rates
R&D pipeline advancement in diabetes, psoriasis, oncology indications
Specialty medicines growth offsetting US generic business competitive headwinds
Geographic revenue diversification: US 27.5%, India 32.3%, Emerging 19.4%
risks: US generic sales declining due to competition; recovery dependent on manufacturing site compliance for new launches
Multiple JAK inhibitors entering alopecia market (RINVOQ); Semaglutide India market will be crowded
CMS Most Favored Nation pricing proposal pending; notice/comment period ends next month
Revlimid contribution ended; gross margin sustainability unclear amid ongoing competitive pressures
